messages:
andrew: Heads-up — rolling fw tighten in eu-west-2 looks like it's blocking keystore/proxy egress. GPU warm-pool nodes fail KMS handshake and hang in PendingProvision. saw audit log write spike too. anyone oncall?

maria: seeing the same. node-init logs: "timeout waiting for kms decrypt". warm-pool stalled ~45m ago. :eyes:

sre-jess: confirmed. 8 nodes failed join in eu-west-2 in the last hour. conntrack shows RSTs to 10.200.5.18:443 (keystore-proxy). which rule was applied?

andrew: rule fw-ephemeral-718 — security pushed it last night to block broad egress for audit export. it unintentionally matched the privatelink/keystore subnet.

security-eli: that was the canary to restrict audit exports (reduce S3 egress). we allowed export-proxy exceptions but missed the keystore host. i'm patching now to add the keystore CIDR exception.

maria: temporary command to re-open until we get a proper rule:```
# temp: allow keystore proxy from gpu subnet
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-llm-keystore --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.200.0.0/16
```

deploy-bot: change fw-ephemeral-718 detected. rollback requested by maria (change-id: ch-2026-04-11-942).

andrew: appreciate the quick roll. FYI we also saw audit-export QPS triple while nodes retried — cost spike incoming. can we get counts by region?

sre-jess: quick counts (from warm-pool metrics): eu-west-2: 12 failed joins, eu-central-1: 1, us-west-2: 0. Audit log writes spiked ~3x in eu-west-2 for ~30m.

pm-raj: that spike projects to roughly +$2.8k/day if sustained. we need to attribute to product vs infra cost center. suggestions?

security-eli: two levers: 1) add CIDR exception for keystore (low risk, done), 2) sample audit logs in non-prod to 25% to curb cost. sampling needs approval from compliance for non-prod.

andrew: longer-term: consider region-priority fallback for keystore so nodes can use a local fallback endpoint (usw2) on failure; avoids provisioning stalls but adds inter-region egress cost.

maria: temp fix applied and nodes restarted. warm-pool recovered to target. I'll follow up with a short postmortem + recommended rule whitelist to avoid repeating.

sre-jess: will add a short dashboard alert to surface keystore handshake failures before full warm-pool impact.

pm-raj: for cost allocation, please tag the audit write events by region and product in the PM ticket so finance can split the bill.

andrew: thanks — big win getting the pool back. follow-up action items: security to finalize exception rule, ops to propose fallback keystore config, pm to get cost tagging.

maria: noted. I'll create the follow-up ticket and include logs + exact rule diffs. :thumbsup:

security-eli: filing compliance request for non-prod sampling decision. will loop in legal if needed. :thinking_face:
